messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 2823456789 — elevated 502/504s observed for gateway-eu-west-1. error rate > 4% over last 3m. auto-pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

amber (oncall): acked. I’m on it — paging SRE now. Marking P1 until we have mitigation or customer impact assessed. @jordan can you confirm scope?

jordan (sre): looking. initial quick scan: spike of upstream timeouts hitting our gateway -> backend pool 'model-proxy-eu' showing high tail latencies. Also seeing a lot of entries with missing trace/span ids coming from the edge layer which is complicating root cause. Logs show many responses like:
```
level=error svc=gateway path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream_error="timeout" request_id="-" span_id="-"
```

jordan (sre): I’m increasing logging on the gateway for kvcache hits and upstream latency (temp) and will flip trace sampling to 100% for the region so we get spans. doing that now.

lee (eng-runtime): quick thought — if span ids are missing, we may have a regression in the edge-injector that drops request-id header when batch proxying occurs. We pushed a light perf patch yesterday; rolling that back as a stopgap might restore traces. Two mitigation paths: 1) enable fallback routing to eu-west-2 for new traffic, 2) toggle injector to always synthesize request_id when absent. Which do you want first?

amber (oncall): do both in parallel. route new traffic to eu-west-2 (gradual) and enable synthesized request_ids in edge. prioritize routing first to drop load.

lee (eng-runtime): issuing routing change via control-plane now — small canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%. command:
```
# control-plane routing API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN" \
  https://control.redwood.internal/v1/routing/adjust \
  -d '{"from":"eu-west-1","to":"eu-west-2","percent":10,"policy":"failover"}'
```

deploy-bot: Routing change applied: canary=10% -> observers: latency baseline unchanged. (deploy-id: r-2026-03-15-017)

jordan (sre): can confirm: after canary to eu-west-2 we see 502 rate drop for the subset. overall error rate down from 4.2% -> 1.1% so routing is helping. Still seeing missing spans for older requests hitting eu-west-1.

lee (eng-runtime): enabled synth-request-id plugin on the edge in eu-west-1 (hotpatch). config:
```
edge.plugins.synth_request_id = true
edge.plugins.debug_kv_logging = true    # temp, high volume
```

amber (oncall): great. please keep debug_kv_logging only for 10m windows. we don't want noise forever.

lee (eng-runtime): noted — setting a 10m TTL and increase sampling to 100% for traces for that TTL. Also adding a tiny structured log to capture kv cache key and upstream peer for any 5xx:
```
logger.error("gateway:5xx", { request_id, span_id, kv_key, upstream_peer, latency_ms })
```

jordan (sre): after synth ids + routing we see last 5m error rate at 0.6% and traces are filling in. starting triage on upstream timeouts — looks like one model-proxy instance had connection pool exhaustion (fd saturation). I’m restarting the small pool and bumping connection limit temporarily.

deploy-bot: restart of model-proxy-eu instance i-09a3b completed. (cmd: svcctl restart model-proxy-eu --instance i-09a3b)

jordan (sre): restarted, connection metrics improving. tail latency for upstream falls back to baseline.

lina (cs): CS note — we have 12 customer tickets opened in the last 30m mentioning timeouts/errors. two enterprise customers reported interruption to end-users, but none reported data loss. sharing a concise customer impact summary to support.

ana (pm): please capture the exact window and estimate affected requests/customers. we need to decide whether to send a post-incident notification to enterprise customers.

jordan (sre): quick numbers: across eu-west-1 cluster ~220k requests in last hour, error ~0.6% after mitigations. peak before mitigations ~4.2% for ~8 minutes -> estimated ~7k failed requests during peak. Persistent impact reduced after 20 minutes.

amber (oncall): good situational awareness. Customer impact: limited to short-lived spikes, some sessions retried, no major data loss. recommend standard incident postmortem and a customer note. @lina can you draft a short message for affected accounts with the timeline?

lina (cs): will draft and send after we confirm final numbers. tentative message: apology, summary, mitigation steps taken, and contact to escalate.

amber (oncall): handing off to SRE for post-incident mitigation and follow-ups. jordan you own the writeup and follow-ups (runbook updates, revert the perf patch if necessary, ensure injector tests), lee owns runtime fix to ensure request_id never drops in batch paths. amber will remain available as incident lead until the postmortem is done.

ana (pm): follow-ups / action items tracked: [1] Revert or patch edge perf change (lee) [2] Add automated probe to detect missing span_id in gateway logs (jordan) [3] Remove debug logging TTL and ensure logging volume back to normal (lee) [4] Customer comms draft (lina) [5] Postmortem and RCA (jordan + amber).

amber (oncall): final quick note — we added a temporary lightweight probe to the observability plane that scans gateway logs for missing request_id/span_id and emits a high-priority alert if >0.5% over 5m. Leaving that probe enabled for 24h. Will revert to normal after closure.

jordan (sre): thanks all — closing active pager for now. leaving this thread open for follow-ups and the postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:

amber (oncall): closing handoff at 2823456825. everyone please update the follow-up checklist in #incidents-triage. :thumbsup:
